title: Activation-tail adaptive layer-scaling and hybrid FP8/INT8 calibration for LLaMA/Mistral/Qwen
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce an activation-tail-aware, per-layer adaptive scaling pass and a hybrid FP8/INT8 calibration workflow to address model-specific activation tail behaviors observed in LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen family models. Goal: recover accuracy regressions introduced by aggressive quant profiles while keeping unit cost benefits from INT8/FP8 execution and minimizing runtime configuration surface for customers.
background: Recent mass-evals showed that tail-heavy activations in select attention and MLP layers cause 1-3% BLEU/qa-score regressions under our current INT8 profiles; FP8 candidate profiles mitigate some regressions but increase memory pressure and jitter. Existing layer-scale fixes are coarse (single scale per-layer) and do not account for per-head or per-position tail variance between models. This ticket defines a workflow: 1) an offline calibration pass that computes a hybrid FP8/INT8 profile per model and per-layer, augmented by activation tail statistics; 2) an adaptive per-layer rescale operator that is applied at quantize-time or as a lightweight runtime shim; 3) an automated accuracy validation suite and rollback gating in CI.
acceptance_criteria: Hybrid calibration harness that produces per-layer profile recommendations (prefer INT8, fall back to FP8 for flagged layers)
Adaptive layer-scaling operator implemented in runtime (can be enabled per-model via model policy)
Validation suite with representative evals for LLaMA-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B shows <=0.5% relative quality regression vs float baseline across benchmark set
CI gating that blocks quantized runtime rollout if any model in nightly regression set exceeds 1.0% QA degradation
Documentation and sample configs added to model catalog and console with explanation of hybrid profiles and the rescale tradeoffs
technical_notes: Calibration harness changes: collect activation peak tail quantiles (90/95/99) per-layer and per-head where applicable during representative token streams
Heuristic for hybrid profile: prefer INT8 if 99th quantile fits within 3.5 sigma of quantization range; otherwise mark layer for FP8 or for extra rescale

Rescale operator design: learn a multiplicative per-layer (and optional per-head) factor from calibration data using a constrained least-squares objective to minimize L2 between float activations and dequantized activations
Runtime overhead: operator must be vectorized and fused into the quant/dequant kernels; target overhead <2% p99 latency on common seq lengths
Fallback policy: model policy can pin layers to FP8 if rescale cannot bring error under threshold; include an automated cost estimate in profile output
Compatibility: maintain same model-ABI (no model graph rewrite) by applying rescale as metadata-driven quant shim for Dedicated and Hosted deployments
implementation_steps: Extend calib harness (calib-service) to emit tail quantiles and candidate rescale factors
Build a lightweight solver service that proposes per-layer/per-head multipliers and cost delta for hybrid FP8/INT8
Add operator to runtime kernels with vectorized fused multiply during dequant path
Wire model catalog to store hybrid-profile JSON and expose toggle in Console per-deployment
Implement CI regression job that runs quantized model through evaluation harness and compares metrics to float baseline
Run canary rollout on Dedicated for small customer cohort before broad Hosted rollout
testing_plan: Unit tests for calibration metric collection (tail quantiles) including synthetic heavy-tail activations
Solver integration tests verifying constraints and determinism
Microbenchmarks for operator overhead across NVidia A10/A100 and AMD MI250 (target <2% latency amplification)
Quality regression suite: instruction-following prompts, summarization, embeddings accuracy on retrieval tasks
A/B experiment in staging comparing hybrid-profile vs baseline INT8 on throughput, latency, and accuracy
Fail-open tests: ensure fallback to float/FP8 works when runtime rescale operator fails or quota exceeded
observability_and_metrics: Expose per-model metrics: percent-of-layers flagged for FP8, aggregate expected token cost delta, observed p50/p95/p99 latency with rescale enabled
Alert if nightly regression set sees >0.75% degradation for any model
Dashboard tile showing distribution of tail quantiles across model catalog to help identify models needing profile updates
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: rescale introduces numerical instability for extremely small activation ranges. Mitigation: clamp learned factors and fall back to FP8 for those layers
Risk: additional kernel complexity increases maintenance burden. Mitigation: implement operator as optional fused path behind feature flag and maintain reference unfused code path
Risk: cost increases for some customers. Mitigation: include cost delta estimate in profile and allow per-customer opt-out via model policy
